pattern: Inline: a labelled region with a toolbar (WAI-ARIA APG Toolbar), a focusable image stage, and thumbnail buttons with aria-current. Lightbox: the same content in a modal dialog (APG Dialog) that restores focus when it closes.

roles.role: region or dialog, named by label
group, named 'Image 2 of 5: alt text', described by the keyboard help
img with the image's alt text
group of buttons named by alt text; the current one has aria-current=true
group, named with its size, described by the crop keyboard help

aria.value: true (they stay focusable in the toolbar)

keyboard.action: Fit the image to the view.
Previous / next image (mirrored in RTL); pans when zoomed in.
Activate the tool or show the image.
Resize the crop area (keeps the aspect ratio).
Cancel the crop; otherwise close the lightbox.

focus: The lightbox moves focus to the stage when it opens and returns it to the previously focused element when it closes. Starting a crop focuses the crop area; applying or cancelling returns focus to the stage.
notes: Every image needs alt text; decorative images are announced as 'Image n'.
Image changes, zoom steps, rotation, crop size changes, and load errors are announced politely.
Pinch and drag have single-pointer alternatives (buttons, keys, double click) for WCAG 2.5.1 and 2.5.7.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
